description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Possessed Skaab
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Possessed Skaab
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
